subject.title: feat(macos): Quick Chat area capture and focused-app text context

question: Should macOS Quick Chat ship an explicit Accessibility-based focused-window text attachment flow, with its stated chip, clearing, and send-time privacy contract?
rationale: This is a new capability that can transmit sensitive foreground-app content; tests can bound implementation behavior but cannot decide the intended product privacy boundary.

options.title: Sponsor the focused-text workflow
options.body: Accept the explicit user-triggered Accessibility capture model after reviewing redacted native proof of the capture, chip lifecycle, and clearing behavior.

options.title: Defer focused-text capture
options.body: Keep area screenshots under review but defer the Accessibility text feature until maintainers define a broader privacy and disclosure design.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the focused-text workflow
recommendation.body: Accept the explicit user-triggered Accessibility capture model after reviewing redacted native proof of the capture, chip lifecycle, and clearing behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The available PR history identifies this contributor as the active implementation contact for the macOS Quick Chat capture work.
